task.brief: Check creating a share through ShareLinkViewSet against the current independently supplied policy. A principal asks to share an existing document; determine which endpoint and object controls apply to that exact document before the share is created. Include relevant inherited permission and serializer paths. Do not assume that document existence or a global model permission grants access to this document. Explain source behavior, policy compliance and specific missing facts.

policy.text: A caller creating a document share must have view_document permission for the exact shared document. A global add_sharelink permission or knowing a document ID alone is insufficient.

behavior.explanation: The visible create path is conditional on an authenticated request, the POST/model-level permission path configured by PaperlessObjectPermissions, and ShareLinkSerializer validation of the exact selected document. The serializer rejects unless user.has_perm("documents.view_document") and has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", document) both succeed. On successful validation, it creates a ShareLink for that document with a generated slug. Exact inherited framework mechanics and the helper's internal exception branches are not shown.

branches.condition: The request is not authenticated.
branches.explanation: ShareLinkViewSet includes IsAuthenticated.

branches.condition: The inherited PaperlessObjectPermissions POST check does not grant the required ShareLink add permission.
branches.explanation: The view applies PaperlessObjectPermissions, whose POST mapping is add_<model>; the view model is ShareLink.

branches.condition: serializer.user is null or user.has_perm("documents.view_document") is false.
branches.explanation: validate_document raises PermissionDenied unless the user exists and the global view_document test succeeds.

branches.condition: has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", selected_document) is false.
branches.explanation: The selected document is rejected before create.

branches.condition: Authentication, the inherited POST permission path, global documents.view_document, and has_perms_owner_aware for the selected document all succeed, and ordinary inherited serializer/model creation succeeds.
branches.explanation: The serializer accepts the exact document, generates a slug, and delegates creation of the ShareLink referring to that document.

missing.detail: The implementation of has_perms_owner_aware was not read, so its precise ownership, guardian, superuser, global-permission, and object-permission success branches remain unspecified.
missing.nextRead: Locate and read the definition of has_perms_owner_aware within the allowed source, if present.

missing.detail: The detailed inherited behavior of DRF CreateModelMixin, GenericViewSet, ModelSerializer, IsAuthenticated, and DjangoObjectPermissions is not contained in the cited repository source ranges.

behavior.explanation: The visible source is structurally consistent with the policy: add_sharelink alone is insufficient, knowing a document ID alone is insufficient, and the serializer invokes an owner-aware view_document check on the exact Document that will be attached to the share. However, conformance cannot be conclusively determined without the implementation semantics of has_perms_owner_aware, because a function name and arguments do not prove that every true branch represents view_document permission for that exact document.

branches.condition: Every true branch of has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", document) represents the caller having view_document permission for that exact document.
branches.explanation: Then the serializer requires the policy's exact-document permission before creating the ShareLink, in addition to—not merely instead of—the add_sharelink path.

branches.condition: The helper can return true based only on global permission, document existence/ID knowledge, or another condition that does not amount to view_document permission for the exact document.
branches.explanation: That branch would permit creation without satisfying the independently supplied exact-document policy.

branches.condition: The caller has the ShareLink add permission but fails either global documents.view_document or the selected-document helper check.
branches.explanation: The visible serializer path makes add_sharelink alone insufficient.

branches.condition: The submitted document identifier resolves to a Document, but one of the serializer's view_document conditions fails.
branches.explanation: Resolution/existence alone does not pass validate_document.

missing.detail: Decisive missing fact: the body and all success branches of has_perms_owner_aware, specifically whether true always establishes view_document permission for the exact Document argument.
missing.nextRead: Read the has_perms_owner_aware definition and any directly invoked permission predicate needed to classify its true branches.

missing.detail: If conformance also depends on runtime overrides or alternate authentication/permission backends, their deployed configuration is not established by this source-visible inquiry.

policyAssessment.explanation: The visible path does not rely on add_sharelink or document-ID knowledge alone and does perform a check parameterized by the exact selected document. The exact semantics of that check remain unread, preventing a definitive satisfied/violated finding.

observations.subject: ShareLinkViewSet create route
observations.claim: The API router registers ShareLinkViewSet under share_links beneath the api URL prefix. The view set includes CreateModelMixin and uses ShareLinkSerializer.

observations.subject: request.user
observations.claim: The view requires IsAuthenticated and PassUserMixin passes self.request.user into serializers derived from SerializerWithPerms; ShareLinkSerializer inherits OwnedObjectSerializer, which inherits SerializerWithPerms.

observations.subject: request document field
observations.claim: ShareLinkSerializer exposes a document field for the ShareLink model, whose document attribute is a foreign key to Document. Its validate_document method receives that selected Document instance and passes the same instance to has_perms_owner_aware.

observations.subject: POST create request
observations.claim: At the view level, PaperlessObjectPermissions maps POST to add_<model>, which for this view's ShareLink model is add_sharelink; the source also requires authentication. Independently, serializer field validation accepts the selected document only when serializer.user is non-null, user.has_perm("documents.view_document") is true, and has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", document) is true; otherwise it raises PermissionDenied before serializer creation.

observations.subject: ShareLinkSerializer.create
observations.object: new ShareLink referring to the selected Document
observations.claim: After successful validation, create adds a random 50-character slug and delegates creation. The resulting model object is a ShareLink whose document foreign key identifies the selected document and whose owner field can identify a user; the exact inherited owner-setting behavior was not read.

observations.subject: has_perms_owner_aware and inherited framework paths
observations.claim: The visible source establishes that has_perms_owner_aware must return true, but its implementation was not read, so ownership, superuser, guardian, or other exact-document branches inside that helper are not established here. Likewise, the detailed CreateModelMixin, ModelSerializer, IsAuthenticated, and DjangoObjectPermissions runtime implementations are dependency behavior not shown in the cited source.

observations.subject: ShareLinkViewSet create route
observations.claim: The relevant source path is the router-registered share_links ShareLinkViewSet using CreateModelMixin, ShareLinkSerializer, IsAuthenticated, and PaperlessObjectPermissions.

observations.subject: authenticated request.user
observations.claim: PassUserMixin binds the request's authenticated user to the serializer.user value used by validate_document.

observations.subject: document supplied for the share
observations.claim: The serializer's document validation is resource-bound: it checks the Document instance selected for the new ShareLink, not merely a document identifier or the ShareLink object.

observations.subject: caller
observations.claim: A global add_sharelink-style POST permission is not sufficient in the visible path: document validation additionally requires global documents.view_document and a true result from has_perms_owner_aware for the selected document. Failure raises PermissionDenied.

observations.subject: successful validated create
observations.claim: The document checked by validate_document is the document field persisted on the newly created ShareLink, so the visible serializer guard and protected effect are bound to the same document.

observations.subject: exact semantics of has_perms_owner_aware
observations.claim: Policy compliance turns on whether has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", document) means that the caller has view_document permission for that exact document under all of its success branches. That implementation and its exceptions are not present in the evidence read, so conformance cannot be declared conclusively from the function name alone.
